A little letter for you 💌

Dear Mrs. Bauni, 💗 Happy Birthday to one of the most special people in my life! Thank you for being you — for the laughs, the memories, the silly moments, and even the little fights that become funny later. Life is brighter with you in it, and I hope this new year brings you so much happiness, confidence, love, and reasons to smile. No matter how much we tease each other, you'll always have a special place in my heart. You deserve all the cake, all the hugs, and all the good things today and always. Keep smiling, keep shining, and never forget how loved you are. 🥹🎀 With lots of love, Your favourite troublemaker ♡
